propositions: Impact-present close landing scan calls resolve_ticket_id per historical candidate, with short-id and generic-prefix branches performing a full tracker-root directory listing each, yielding O(unique_candidates × tracker) scaling
Current implementation performs 82 tracker-root os.listdir scans for 80 distinct non-alias candidates plus an alias target, before completion verification even runs

Short-id-shaped tokens and ordinary subject-prefix references fall through the alias index and into the per-candidate os.listdir branches, unlike alias references which are already bounded by an index

Fix replaces per-candidate resolution with a single prebuilt resolver index (alias map + sorted dir-name list) and uses bisect prefix-matching, reducing tracker scans from 82 to 1 while preserving all reference-form semantics and descendant credit
Descendant ticket credit, file-impact-vs-diff enforcement, trailing reference forms, and fail-closed git-error semantics remain unchanged after the fix
RED-first regression test test_referencing_commits_bounded_scans_for_non_alias_candidates now passes with bounded scan count ≤1 and fails on the per-candidate implementation
